_comment: Handgepflegt (Issue #99): Englischer 'Was ist neu'-Text für GENAU die Version im Feld 'version'. Der CHANGELOG ist nur deutsch und wird nicht maschinell übersetzt (Owner-Entscheidung) - 'title' und 'en' werden beim Release von Hand geschrieben, sinngemäß zum deutschen CHANGELOG-Abschnitt derselben Version. Der Generator (scripts/generate-whatsnew.mjs) übernimmt 'en' NUR, wenn 'version' hier exakt zur aktuellen APP_VERSION passt - sonst bleibt EN absichtlich leer, damit eine vergessene Übersetzung nicht lautlos durchrutscht (siehe web/scripts/check-whatsnew.mjs).
en:
Backup before updating recommended. On first start PokéCollect adds a new table for scan checks; existing data stays as it is. Update the image matcher too — the scan check needs its new interface.

• New: per-card scan review (multiple cards, binder page) — save, discard or rescan each card on its own, and add a card the scan missed by outlining it in the photo. The buttons at the bottom save the rest.
• New: copy with other details — when scanning several copies, give one of them its own foiling or another set (same name, same artwork).
• New: image language — show the catalog image in another language (EN, DE, FR, ES, IT, PT), while scanning and on the card page.
• New: weak scans (admin portal) — checks saved scan photos against their card's catalog image and lists skewed crops and poor matches. "Fix crop" opens the card with suggested corners.
• New: fix crop on the card page for every card with an original photo, also when it shows the catalog image.
• New: dataset export — the check result per photo, all cards per original photo and card outlines in YOLO format, to train recognition of multiple cards and whole binder pages.
• New: binder page slider next to the arrows.
• Changed: English interface — server error messages, stored choice values (priority, pattern, sealed type and state), card names in statistics and dialogs, amounts and dates in your browser's format, the CSV export (comma, decimal point, English columns) and the scanner's reading prompt are now English. The catalog sorts by the English name.
• Changed: new cards use the app language unless you set a default language (new option "Same as the app language"); cards added by hand get the name in their card language.
• Fixed: re-cropping a photo on the card page lost or kept stale corners.
title: Scan checks, per-card scan review and the English interface
